svg.title: Three full wallpaper drops from a 33 foot roll
svg.desc: A 396 inch roll provides three 100 inch blanks, with 96 inches remaining. At 20.5 inches wide and 96 inches installed height, three drops cover 41 square feet.

g.text: Count full drops, not just square feet
Example roll: 20.5 inches wide × 396 inches long (33 feet)
Each blank: 96-inch wall height + 4 inches total trimming allowance
3 drops × 20.5 inches = 61.5 inches of wall width
The 96-inch remainder is too short for another 100-inch blank.
No pattern repeat in this example. Matching, corners and defects can reduce the yield.
